ailment_devices.description: Conditions involving blood sugar regulation, insulin resistance, and metabolic monitoring.

devices.name: Blood Glucose Meter
devices.description: Electronic device used to measure blood sugar concentration.

devices.name: Glucose Test Strips
devices.description: Disposable chemical strips inserted into a meter for blood samples.

devices.name: Lancing Device & Lancets
devices.description: Spring-loaded needle tool used to prick the skin for capillary blood samples.

devices.name: Insulin Syringes / Pen Needles
devices.description: Sterile needles and barrels used for subcutaneous insulin administration.

devices.name: Insulin Pens / Pumps
devices.description: Devices used to deliver continuous or bolus doses of insulin.

devices.name: Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM)
devices.description: Subcutaneous sensor providing real-time interstitial glucose readings.

devices.name: Ketone Meter & Strips
devices.description: Device for measuring blood or urine ketone bodies (crucial for Type 1).

ailment_devices.description: Disorders affecting upper airway collapse during sleep and chronic obstructive pulmonary conditions.

devices.name: CPAP / BiPAP Machine
devices.description: Flow generator providing pressurized air to keep airways open during sleep.

devices.name: CPAP Mask & Headgear
devices.description: Nasal, full-face, or pillow interface securing airflow from the machine.

devices.name: CPAP Heated Humidifier & Tubing
devices.description: Water chamber and hose system to condition air and prevent dryness.

devices.name: Pulse Oximeter
devices.description: Finger-clip sensor measuring blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) and pulse rate.

devices.name: Peak Flow Meter
devices.description: Mechanical device measuring maximum speed of expiration (asthma/COPD tracking).

devices.name: Nebulizer & Masks
devices.description: Compressor system turning liquid medication into an aerosol mist for inhalation.

ailment_devices.description: Hypertension, heart failure, arrhythmias, and clotting risk monitoring.

devices.name: Digital Blood Pressure Monitor
devices.description: Upper-arm cuff device measuring systolic, diastolic pressure, and heart rate.

devices.name: ECG / EKG Monitor (e.g., Kardia)
devices.description: Portable single-lead or multi-lead electrocardiogram for rhythm analysis.

devices.name: Coagulation Meter (INR Monitor)
devices.description: Handheld device testing blood clotting times for patients on anticoagulants.

devices.name: Digital Weight Scale
devices.description: High-precision scale for daily fluid retention monitoring in heart failure.

devices.name: Compression Stockings
devices.description: Medical-grade graduated hosiery for venous return and edema management.

ailment_devices.description: Arthritis, joint inflammation, chronic pain, and mobility limitations.

devices.name: Hot / Cold Therapy Packs
devices.description: Reusable gel packs or electric heating pads for joint inflammation and pain relief.

devices.name: TENS Unit
devices.description: Transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation device for managing localized chronic pain.

devices.name: Grip Strength Dynamometer
devices.description: Handheld device measuring isometric grip force to track hand arthritis progression.

devices.name: Mobility Aids (Cane, Walker, Rollator)
devices.description: Support frames and wheeled walkers to assist with stability and unweighting joints.

devices.name: Orthopedic Braces & Splints
devices.description: Stabilizing supports for knees, wrists, ankles, or spine.

devices.name: Long-handled Reachers & Dressing Aids
devices.description: Ergonomic tools to minimize joint bending and strain during daily tasks.

ailment_devices.description: Kidney disease, chronic urinary retention, and fluid balance tracking.

devices.name: Urine Collection Hat & Containers
devices.description: Graduated receptacles for measuring 24-hour urine output volume.

devices.name: Urinalysis Test Strips
devices.description: Multi-parameter dipsticks testing for protein, blood, and specific gravity.

devices.name: Intermittent Urinary Catheters
devices.description: Sterile single-use tubes for bladder drainage if retention is present.

devices.name: Digital Precision Scale
devices.description: Scale used for rigorous dry-weight and fluid balance tracking.

ailment_devices.description: Digestive disorders, hydration therapy, and specialized nutritional needs.

devices.name: Kitchen Food Scale
devices.description: Precision gram scale for carbohydrate counting and portion control.

devices.name: Enteral Feeding Pump & Bags
devices.description: Mechanical pump systems for tube-fed nutrition (if applicable).

devices.name: Hydration Water Bottle with Volume Markings
devices.description: Graduated vessel for tracking strict fluid intake goals.

ailment_devices.description: Migraines, sleep disturbances, cognitive tracking, and mood disorders.

devices.name: Migraine Cooling Headband / Ice Cap
devices.description: Therapeutic wrap for vasoconstriction and acute headache relief.

devices.name: Sleep Tracking Headband / Mat
devices.description: Non-wearable or wearable sensors analyzing sleep architecture and stages.

devices.name: Light Therapy Box
devices.description: High-lux therapeutic lamp for seasonal affective management and circadian alignment.

ailment_devices.description: Universal hygiene and safety supplies required across multiple home-care regimes.

devices.name: Alcohol Swabs
devices.description: Sterile isopropyl alcohol prep pads for skin disinfection prior to injections or testing.

devices.name: Sharps Disposal Container
devices.description: Puncture-resistant biohazard container for safe disposal of needles and lancets.

devices.name: Medical Exam Gloves
devices.description: Nitrile or latex disposable gloves for sterile or hygienic procedures.

devices.name: Adhesive Bandages & Gauze Pads
devices.description: Wound care dressings for puncture sites and minor skin breaks.
